messages:
Nora: quick flag 5262 noticed a small customer hitting a reconnect loop after we flipped the ws-idle-rollout.
Jamal: saw spike in socket opens at ~03:40 UTC. client went into reconnect jitter every ~12s.
Priya: do we have a capture? sounds like idle-probe TTL mismatch between proxy and runtime.
Nora: capture attached in S3 (link). repro: open WS, idle for 30s, server sends ping-close, client reconnects and gets routed to different shard and gets new token -> billing increments.
Jamal: routing policy sticky-lease TTL is 20s in canary; proxy idle-close window is 30s. client reconnect happened after lease expired -> new session.
Priya: so two problems: (1) idle-close vs lease TTL mismatch causing shard reselection, (2) console shows only total reconnects, not unique resumed sessions -> hard to triage.
ThrottleBot: alert: reconnects > baseline by 4x for user: acme-inc for 12m.
Nora: guess: client didn't do resume handshake because server returned a hard close. Need to plumb resume hint on close frames so client attempts resume instead of fresh auth.
Jamal: short-term mitigation: increase sticky-lease TTL to 45s in canary and align proxy idle-close to 40s. Will push a hotfix to rollout config.
Priya: medium-term: change close code to include X-Resume-Allowed header and a resume token in the close payload. Also update routing to prefer same-shard for 60s if resume-allowed.
Nora: console action item: add a split panel "reconnect_attempts" vs "successful_resumes" and surface per-route sticky-lease TTL.
ConsoleUI: open ticket for dashboard: "ws: reconnects / resumes" plus tooltip showing current rollout values for sticky-lease and idle-close. can show edge vs runtime values.
Jamal: I'll open PR for lease TTL bump -> canary 5% then monitor ThrottleBot alerts.
Priya: add e2e test: simulate idle-close and assert client sends resume within 10s and only single billing increment.
Nora: thanks. assign: Jamal -> config rollout, Priya -> protocol change + tests, ConsoleUI -> dashboard. follow up in 6h and keep canary at 5% until green. :+1:
